title: vault-meta-ntv7 — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the NTV7 vault.meta generation: the NTV6 frame byte for byte (magic NTV7, protocol_version 0x02, reserved 0x00, the 345-byte base, the group-key package, the epoch and the sealed roster), with two changes. The three recovery-phrase wrap fields (recovery salt at offset 49, recovery nonce at 153, recovery-wrapped root_key at 177) MUST be all zero, and the frame carries a fixed 1208-byte person envelope after the roster: ml_kem_ct (1088) || ed_ephemeral_pk (32) || nonce (24) || wrapped_root_key (64). Total length is 445 + roster_len + 1208 with trailing bytes invalid. A live (non-zero) phrase-wrap field is a STRUCTURAL rejection, not a supported state: nothing on disk could say whether the saved phrase still opens the vault. The person wrap's AAD is role 'person-wrap-root-key' over the recipient fingerprint and the frame's own items_key_id, deliberately not the vault id and not the account number hash. Reference implementation: protocol/src/vault_meta_ntv7.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'vault-meta-ntv7/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: roundtrip — parse then re-serialize is byte-identical

input_blob_hex.description: The whole frame. Length must be 445 + roster_len + 1208.

expected_blob_hex.description: What a parse-then-serialize must reproduce exactly. Equal to input_blob_hex for a valid frame; the separate field is what makes the assertion explicit rather than a port re-echoing its input.

expected_signed_roster_len.description: The u32 BE roster length at offset 441; the roster itself starts at 445.

expected_base_account_number_hash_hex.description: Base field at offset 6, read through the generation-agnostic base reader.

expected_base_items_key_id_hex.description: Base field at offset 241. Also the AAD's vault binding for the person wrap.

expected_person_wrap_ml_kem_ct_hex.description: 1088-byte ML-KEM-768 ciphertext, the first field of the person envelope.

expected_person_wrap_nonce_hex.description: 24-byte AEAD nonce for the person envelope.

expected_person_wrap_wrapped_root_key_he.description: 64 bytes: root_key ciphertext (32) || CTX commitment (32). The Poly1305 tag is NOT stored; aead_seal_ctx folds it into the commitment and recomputes it at open. That is why this is 64 and not 80.

oneOf.title: parse_fail — a structural rejection the frame must refuse

informational_reason.description: Which rule this case trips. Informational only: the rejection is deliberately ONE non-distinguishing result, so a port must not surface the reason.

oneOf.title: person_wrap_open — the envelope opens to one root key

input_kem_seed_hex.description: 64-byte ML-KEM seed (d || z). Deterministic: the same seed derives the same keypair in any port.

expected_root_key_hex.description: The 32-byte vault root_key the envelope seals.

oneOf.title: person_wrap_open_fail — tampering or a foreign vault fails closed

input_items_key_id_hex.description: The AAD's vault binding. One case supplies ANOTHER vault's id, which is the only way a same-owner port would otherwise open.
